_comment: SAVEMAP_CONFIG button-remap table (init.out/save offsets 0x08-0x13). Each physical button slot stores the id of the logical action it triggers (config value = action bit + 1; default = its own slot + 1; 0 = unassigned). Action names/behaviours identified from IDA (sub_4A2D60 remap core and its consumers). The 12 slots are bits 0-11 of the engine pad mask, which is the PSX DualShock button word (Input_WritePsxPadButtons): bits 9-10 are L3/R3. They are only reachable on PSX with an analog pad - the PC input layer (sub_498550) has no command mapped to 0x200/0x400.

action.name: Unassigned
action.note: Physical button triggers no logical action

action.name: Flee (hold)
action.note: Held together with the other Flee action = attempt to flee battle

action.name: Flee (hold)
action.note: Held together with the other Flee action = attempt to flee battle

action.name: Menu page / prev character
action.note: Page-left / previous character in menus (default L1)

action.name: Renzokuken / next character
action.note: Renzokuken critical-timing press in battle; next character in menus (default R1)

action.name: Confirm / Talk
action.note: Confirm in menus; talk/examine (primary) in the field

action.name: Reset controls
action.note: Resets the button config to default (Controls submenu only)

action.name: L3 action
action.note: Logical L3 (pad bit 0x200). Its Controls-menu row is greyed out unless an analog/DualShock pad is connected, and the PC input layer can never emit this bit

action.name: R3 action
action.note: Logical R3 (pad bit 0x400). Its Controls-menu row is greyed out unless an analog/DualShock pad is connected, and the PC input layer can never emit this bit

action.name: Pause / Start
action.note: Pause / system menu (Start is read from the physical button, bypassing remap)
